memory_retrieval_efficiency.description: LoCoMo-style memory retrieval: accuracy with token and search-cost constraints, reflecting the paper's headline accuracy-efficiency claim.

hit_at_1.description: Fraction of questions whose top-ranked retrieved memory entry is answer-bearing.

hit_at_3.description: Fraction of questions with any answer-bearing memory entry in the allowed top-three retrieval set.

gold_entry_recall.description: Average fraction of all labeled supporting entries recovered, catching partial multi-hop retrieval.

answer_token_f1.description: Token overlap between the retrieved evidence text and the gold answer.

worst_category_hit_at_1.description: Lowest top-one hit rate across single-hop, multi-hop, and temporal question groups.

reconstruction_exact_match.description: Rate at which retrieved reconstructed text exactly matches the canonical memory entry text after token normalization.

avg_retrieved_entries.description: Average number of entries returned per question, discouraging always filling the retrieval budget.

avg_token_footprint.description: Average number of retrieved evidence tokens per question, measuring context-budget cost.

avg_bit_operations.description: Average machine-independent bit-operation proxy for retrieval search work.
